title: Illinois officials investigate apparent cyberattack on Algonquin Dam
date_note: Gizmodo (published 21 Nov) says the operator detected the Nov. 16 incident; the disclosure was reported around 20 to 21 Nov.
geo_basis: Algonquin Dam on the Fox River, Illinois, as named by Gizmodo; town centre
summary: Gizmodo reports that the Illinois Department of Natural Resources said Algonquin Dam on the Fox River "was subject to a cyberattack earlier this week"; the dam operator detected the Nov. 16 incident. CBS Chicago relays IDNR as calling it an apparent cyberattack, and the Chicago Tribune and ABC 7 described it as attempted, per Gizmodo. IDNR said it took immediate action to keep the dam secure and fully operational.
plain: Illinois officials say Algonquin Dam was subject to an apparent cyberattack. Some outlets call it an attempt. IDNR says it acted to keep the dam secure and fully operational.
exec: A US dam operator reports a cyberattack; IDNR says the dam stayed secure and fully operational.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Operators of dams and water systems can watch for IDNR and CISA updates.
impact: IDNR says it took immediate action to keep the dam secure and fully operational.

sources.name: CBS Chicago: Illinois officials investigating 'apparent cyberattack' at Algonquin Dam on Fox River
BNO News: Illinois investigates apparent cyberattack on Fox River dam

validation.note: Gizmodo and CBS Chicago each state the IDNR's statement of an apparent cyberattack at the dam; BNO News relays CBS. The IDNR release itself was not read.

review.note: Read Gizmodo, CBS Chicago, BNO. Title said attempted but IDNR/CBS say apparent; attempted is Tribune/ABC 7 per Gizmodo and BNO's own wording. Title, summary, plain now use apparent with attribution. Date 16 Nov, operator detection, no-impact wording match. IDNR release not read.
